note: Arapaho NF (Sulphur RD) in the Fraser Experimental Forest, 4 mi southwest of Fraser on CR 73 (St. Louis Creek Rd), ~8,900 ft; trailheads for Byers Peak and St. Louis Lake nearby. The loop sits on open, logged-over ground north of St. Louis Creek, with a willow bottom between. --Claude
summary: FS page + forest status table + recreation.gov: confirmed $29, no hookups, reservable on recreation.gov. Added 17 sites (12 reservable, 5 FCFS), 25-ft max vehicle length (FS + rec.gov; the status table says 32-ft spur), pull-throughs, vault toilets/drinking water, season May 15 - Sept 20, booking (2-day cutoff, 14 nights, reservation season May 15 - Sept 19). Note cleaned.
flags: Phone missing: Sulphur Ranger District Office 970-295-6600 (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/offices; the same number the forest prints for the Supervisor's Office in Fort Collins - ARP routes both through it). recreation.gov's facility phone 530-529-0578 is the concessionaire's.

Length conflict (all clear EKKO): FS page 'Maximum Vehicle Length: 25' and recreation.gov 'Maximum Vehicle Length is 25 feet'; the forest's Campground Status table 'Max Spur 32’'; the catalog's per-site Max Vehicle Length runs 24-55 ft (four pull-throughs at 54-55). Recorded 25.
Site count conflict: catalog and status table 17; FS page 'There are 16 non-electric sites'; recreation.gov description '18 non-electric single-party units'. Recorded 17.

Booking: every catalog site's permitted equipment is Car, Fifth Wheel, Pop up, Tent, Trailer - no RV/Motorhome type. A motorhome search on recreation.gov may not offer these sites; worth checking before booking EKKO.
Operator: concessionaire (recreation.gov refund notice names 'the campground concessionaire'; Morrison CO mailing address); ownership left federal.

Waterfront (stored not waterfront, kept): on imagery the loop's south sites are ~60-70 m from St. Louis Creek (a ~5-8 m meandering stream), with a ~30-40 m willow bottom between - a real buffer, so not creekside. The stored evidence's '~150-250m' overstates the distance. Note text 'along the St. Louis Creek' dropped.

Pin: stored 39.9240,-105.8590 is at the loop's northeast entrance, ~100 m from its centre; the FS page's 39.9231,-105.8611 is at the loop's west end; recreation.gov's facility point (39.928606,-105.858471) is ~500 m north on CR 73. Stored pin is fine.
Roads: CR 73 / NFSR 160 (St. Louis Creek off CR 73) 'OPEN | Open Year Round' in the ARP road status table.
